KeyPassages: Song of Solomon 4:5; Song of Solomon 7:3
BiblicalUsage: tsᵉbîyâh is the ordinary word for a female gazelle. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Song of Solomon 4:5 and Song of Solomon 7:3.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsᵉbîyâh is one of the small details that matter in Scripture.
